__comments.suffix_reoptimization_v2_1: Enable only the independently selected suffix v2.1 sidecar.
__comments.suffix_v2_1_model_contract: Qwen2.5/Qwen2 causal LM only; every mixed inputs_embeds forward uses use_cache=false.
__comments.suffix_v2_1_global_optimizer: One persistent Adam over effective positions only; anchor refresh never recreates it.
__comments.suffix_v2_1_local_optimizer: At most one per-position vector-repair trial, with one persistent Adam inside that trial.
__comments.suffix_v2_1_vocab_regularizer: Legal-vocabulary chunked top-k anchors with normalized stable soft-min.
__comments.suffix_v2_1_candidate_policy: Normal embedding 10 plus PPL 10 plus current token; at most one expanded embedding-20 rerank.
__comments.suffix_v2_1_diagnostics: Oracle diagnostics run only after the formal result is frozen and cannot alter it.
